name: LOTTE rental co.,ltd.
summary: LOTTE rental co.,ltd. is a South Korean enterprise specializing in rental solutions. Its offerings encompass a wide array of rental products, including automobiles, various types of equipment, household items, and office gear. Beyond rentals, the company extends its services to include vehicle maintenance and orchestrates auto auctions. Originally established as KT Rental Co., Ltd., the firm officially rebranded to LOTTE rental co.,ltd. on June 24, 2015. With its establishment dating back to 1986, the company's main operations are directed from its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
